name: Kano
source:
Kano's one of the four individuals who made their way to Sarubotoke Island on a mission.
Don't let her tender age fool you - this little lady's got a wild side and a grown-up attitude, especially when it comes to matters of a carnal nature. She's currently under the wing of Arai Zenjirou, her "Uncle" (Occhan) as she adoringly calls him.

"Hey, Uncle. Mind giving me a head pat?"
